description: Provision an AWS Dsql Cluster via the ACK dsql controller. Fields mirror the dsql.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1 Cluster spec.

deletionProtectionEnabled.description:
If enabled, you can't delete your cluster. You must first disable this property
before you can delete your cluster.

kmsEncryptionKey.description:
The KMS key that encrypts and protects the data on your cluster. You can
specify the ARN, ID, or alias of an existing key or have Amazon Web Services
create a default key for you.

Regex Pattern: `^[a-zA-Z0-9:/_-]+$`

kmsEncryptionKeyRef.description:
AWSResourceReferenceWrapper provides a wrapper around *AWSResourceReference
type to provide more user friendly syntax for references using 'from' field
Ex:
APIIDRef:

	from:
	  name: my-api

from.description:
AWSResourceReference provides all the values necessary to reference another
k8s resource for finding the identifier(Id/ARN/Name)

multiRegionProperties.description:
The configuration settings when creating a multi-Region cluster, including
the witness region and linked cluster properties.

clusters.description: A list of the Amazon Resource Names of the cluster.

policy.description:
An optional resource-based policy document in JSON format that defines access
permissions for the cluster.

region.description: AWS region for this resource (e.g. eu-west-1). Rendered as the services.k8s.aws/region annotation. Empty inherits the ACK controller's default region.
region.title: AWS region

tags.description: A map of key and value pairs to use to tag your cluster.

title: AWS Dsql Cluster
